description: This PHP source file defines the 'Template' controller class for the OpenCart admin system, specifically handling tasks related to catalog template translations, including listing, writing, and clearing translation files.

classes.name: Template
classes.description: Controller class for managing catalog template translation tasks within the OpenCart admin system.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates a list of translation routes for catalog templates across stores and languages, and schedules translation tasks.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes translated language data to JSON files based on route, store, and language identifiers.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Deletes generated translation files for all stores and languages.
